name: smwpatches-update-vertical-scroll-on-enemy-bounce
title: Update Vertical Scroll on Enemy Bounce
description:
This patch updates the vertical position of the camera when Mario bounces off of an enemy in levels where vertical scroll at will is enabled, similarly to how the camera updates when Mario lands on a platform.

It works by updating the flag that determines whether or not the camera scrolls up to Mario at the start of the boost subroutine that determines whether or not to give Mario a big jump when bouncing off enemies.
